headline: Congress renamed a post office building in Danville, Vermont, as the "Thaddeus Stevens Post Office."
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 35 Park Street in Danville, Vermont, the "Thaddeus Stevens Post Office." It changes only the name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on November 26, 2014.
